card.name: Start of first term after WARNINGS heading
card.fires_on: The first piece of the first word, often a split medical term, right after a WARNING or WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS heading in drug labels.

modes.label: Split term after WARNINGS
modes.description: A broken-up word such as PAR, NE, AN or TR starts the heading text after WARNINGS.

modes.label: QT after precautions heading
modes.description: QT begins the first listed warning in section 5.
modes.example: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS<< QT>> Prolongation : Avoid use in
